verdict.rationale: The RTX 5070 Ti is a graphics card, and bulk operations across many items is a software/workflow automation axis that does not fit a GPU hardware product. The closest evidence is that the separate NVIDIA app can 'update hundreds of games' with DLSS features. That is companion-software functionality and does not clearly describe a simultaneous bulk action, so the wrong-axis exception is not triggered.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
